text_block_list.text:
One day, I came to the library to put 
together a training regimen, but……

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...No, this one feels too safe as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she has a tendency to play it safe 
in everything. Whether it's races or 
training.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If it rains, do the same amount of 
exercise indoors. If fatigue builds up, 
adjust the schedule and use the time for 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Constructing safe logic makes inference 
easy. In that respect, whatever lies 
beyond staking risks remains an 
unknownâfor better or worse.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...If that is the case, I have concluded 
that taking a slight risk is worthwhile to 
broaden the scope of our deductions.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And so, I drew up a plan assuming dirt 
track training to avoid any injuries, but—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I just realized something. This is 
literally playing it safe!
choice_data_list:
Rather than overthinking it, action is 
key.
Getting hurt defeats the whole purpose.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: My head? Are you saying my head isâah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I hear the word "head," um, I 
can't help feeling like people are teasing 
me about the size of mine...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me. You mean to say that without 
action, it remains mere theoretical 
speculation, correct?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Act before you think... I see. I suppose 
that certainly sounds reckless enough.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I feel like I've gotten the 
hang of something.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, playing it safe is 
fine? If you say so, then it must be so.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... In that case, this training theory 
isn't pointless after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Say, if it's no trouble, would you mind 
taking a look at the training theories I 
came up with?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Safe Training Methods That Allow You to 
Push Your Limits" ...or so she claims.

I was shown her training philosophy. It 
was safe and efficient... a textbook 
approach.
